jobs.description:
About Vitalize

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $32M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

Our Values

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story - interview with us to hear them!

🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.
🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.
🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort — we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.
💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it — no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

About Vitalize's Post-Sales

Our Post-Sales organization owns the customer lifecycle from signature through deployment, adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion. The org is currently comprised of three teams. Deployments gets customers live and to value quickly; Customer Success serves as the strategic partner to our customers, owning executive relationships, driving adoption and measurable value, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships; and Support keeps customers successful day-to-day.

This isn't traditional software implementation. Vitalize changes how thousands of frontline staff, managers, staffing teams, and executives work every day. As we scale to 100+ hospitals, we need these three functions to operate as one system — delivering transformational change for our customers while becoming faster, more predictable, and more scalable with every deployment.

The Role

As VP, Customer Success & Delivery, you'll lead our Customer Success, Deployments, and Support teams and own the outcomes of the entire post-sales organization.

You'll be accountable for getting customers live quickly, driving adoption and measurable ROI, delivering best-in-class retention, and growing our existing partnerships. Just as importantly, you'll build the organization that allows us to do this at significantly greater scale — developing leaders, hiring exceptional talent, improving how the three teams work together, and increasing the number of customers and ARR we can support per person.

You'll operate at every altitude: developing the strategy and operating system for Post-Sales, coaching leaders and ICs, making hard portfolio and resourcing decisions, and personally engaging with executives across our most strategic health system relationships.

What You'll Do

Build and lead a world-class Post-Sales organization. Set the vision and strategy for Customer Success, Deployments, and Support. Develop exceptional leaders, raise the bar for talent, and evolve the organizational structure as we scale from dozens to hundreds of hospitals.
Own customer outcomes and the number. Be accountable for retention and NRR across our customer base, setting the strategy and standards for how we drive adoption, value realization, customer health, and growth. Build toward a future where Customer Success owns an increasing share of the expansion motion directly.
Create one cohesive customer lifecycle. Lead Deployments, Customer Success, and Support as one organization, establishing clear ownership and accountability from signature through deployment, adoption, renewal, and expansion.
Set the strategy for faster, more scalable delivery. Establish the vision for how Vitalize deploys increasingly complex customers with greater speed and predictability. Empower your leaders to build the systems, playbooks, and capabilities that improve time-to-value and capacity cycle over cycle.
Raise the bar for how we demonstrate customer value. Establish the standard for how Vitalize measures and communicates adoption, operational impact, and financial ROI — ensuring our customers and their executives understand the value we're creating.
Own our most strategic customer relationships. Build trusted relationships with CNOs, COOs, CIOs, CFOs, and other health system executives. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic accounts and step directly into the moments where senior leadership can change the outcome.
Make the hard portfolio and investment decisions. Set priorities across customers, resources, and team capacity. Make clear tradeoffs about where we invest, what we commit to, and where we push back — and hold the organization accountable for those decisions.
Represent the voice of the customer at the company level. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to turn patterns across our customers into company strategy, balancing customer needs with building a scalable product and business.
Build for the next order of magnitude. Design the organization, leadership structure, and strategy required to support dramatically more customers and ARR — using product, automation, process, and customer ownership to create leverage rather than scaling headcount linearly.

What You'll Bring

You've scaled a post-sales organization in a high-growth environment. You've hired, ramped, and built leadership layers as the company grew — and can speak concretely to what broke at each stage and how you adapted.
You've owned retention and NRR. You know how to translate adoption, customer health, executive relationships, and demonstrated value into retention and growth. Experience building a CS-led expansion motion is a plus.
You've developed strong leaders. You've coached managers, developed leaders from within, and evolved your org structure and talent as the company scaled.
You know complex enterprise delivery. You've led deployments requiring workflow change, integrations, training, executive alignment, and adoption across large organizations.
You can operate in the executive room and the weeds. You're as comfortable discussing ROI with a CFO or navigating an escalation with a CNO as you are diagnosing why an implementation is slipping.
You make hard tradeoffs. You can prioritize across competing customers and scarce resources, articulate a defensible rationale, and own the outcome.
You partner effectively with Product. You can turn patterns across customers into product signal without turning the roadmap into a collection of customer commitments.
You've built without a playbook. You're comfortable when the product, organization, and processes are all evolving — and see building the system as part of the job.
You understand healthcare, or can get there quickly. Health system experience — particularly in nursing, workforce management, or hospital operations — is a strong advantage. You understand the complexity of clinical workflows, stakeholders, and organizational dynamics.
Ability to travel. You’re excited to spend 40–50% of your time onsite with our customers.

About Vitalize

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $32M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.

Our Values

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story - interview with us to hear them!

🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.
🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.
🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort — we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.
💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it — no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

About Vitalize's Post-Sales

Our Post-Sales organization owns the customer lifecycle from signature through deployment, adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion. The org is currently comprised of three teams. Deployments gets customers live and to value quickly; Customer Success serves as the strategic partner to our customers, owning executive relationships, driving adoption and measurable value, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships; and Support keeps customers successful day-to-day.

This isn't traditional software implementation. Vitalize changes how thousands of frontline staff, managers, staffing teams, and executives work every day. As we scale to 100+ hospitals, we need these three functions to operate as one system — delivering transformational change for our customers while becoming faster, more predictable, and more scalable with every deployment.

The Role

As VP, Customer Success & Delivery, you'll lead our Customer Success, Deployments, and Support teams and own the outcomes of the entire post-sales organization.

You'll be accountable for getting customers live quickly, driving adoption and measurable ROI, delivering best-in-class retention, and growing our existing partnerships. Just as importantly, you'll build the organization that allows us to do this at significantly greater scale — developing leaders, hiring exceptional talent, improving how the three teams work together, and increasing the number of customers and ARR we can support per person.

You'll operate at every altitude: developing the strategy and operating system for Post-Sales, coaching leaders and ICs, making hard portfolio and resourcing decisions, and personally engaging with executives across our most strategic health system relationships.

What You'll Do

Build and lead a world-class Post-Sales organization. Set the vision and strategy for Customer Success, Deployments, and Support. Develop exceptional leaders, raise the bar for talent, and evolve the organizational structure as we scale from dozens to hundreds of hospitals.
Own customer outcomes and the number. Be accountable for retention and NRR across our customer base, setting the strategy and standards for how we drive adoption, value realization, customer health, and growth. Build toward a future where Customer Success owns an increasing share of the expansion motion directly.
Create one cohesive customer lifecycle. Lead Deployments, Customer Success, and Support as one organization, establishing clear ownership and accountability from signature through deployment, adoption, renewal, and expansion.
Set the strategy for faster, more scalable delivery. Establish the vision for how Vitalize deploys increasingly complex customers with greater speed and predictability. Empower your leaders to build the systems, playbooks, and capabilities that improve time-to-value and capacity cycle over cycle.
Raise the bar for how we demonstrate customer value. Establish the standard for how Vitalize measures and communicates adoption, operational impact, and financial ROI — ensuring our customers and their executives understand the value we're creating.
Own our most strategic customer relationships. Build trusted relationships with CNOs, COOs, CIOs, CFOs, and other health system executives. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic accounts and step directly into the moments where senior leadership can change the outcome.
Make the hard portfolio and investment decisions. Set priorities across customers, resources, and team capacity. Make clear tradeoffs about where we invest, what we commit to, and where we push back — and hold the organization accountable for those decisions.
Represent the voice of the customer at the company level. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to turn patterns across our customers into company strategy, balancing customer needs with building a scalable product and business.
Build for the next order of magnitude. Design the organization, leadership structure, and strategy required to support dramatically more customers and ARR — using product, automation, process, and customer ownership to create leverage rather than scaling headcount linearly.

What You'll Bring

You've scaled a post-sales organization in a high-growth environment. You've hired, ramped, and built leadership layers as the company grew — and can speak concretely to what broke at each stage and how you adapted.
You've owned retention and NRR. You know how to translate adoption, customer health, executive relationships, and demonstrated value into retention and growth. Experience building a CS-led expansion motion is a plus.
You've developed strong leaders. You've coached managers, developed leaders from within, and evolved your org structure and talent as the company scaled.
You know complex enterprise delivery. You've led deployments requiring workflow change, integrations, training, executive alignment, and adoption across large organizations.
You can operate in the executive room and the weeds. You're as comfortable discussing ROI with a CFO or navigating an escalation with a CNO as you are diagnosing why an implementation is slipping.
You make hard tradeoffs. You can prioritize across competing customers and scarce resources, articulate a defensible rationale, and own the outcome.
You partner effectively with Product. You can turn patterns across customers into product signal without turning the roadmap into a collection of customer commitments.
You've built without a playbook. You're comfortable when the product, organization, and processes are all evolving — and see building the system as part of the job.
You understand healthcare, or can get there quickly. Health system experience — particularly in nursing, workforce management, or hospital operations — is a strong advantage. You understand the complexity of clinical workflows, stakeholders, and organizational dynamics.
Ability to travel. You’re excited to spend 40–50% of your time onsite with our customers.

AI has transformed B2B SaaS, but has struggled to penetrate the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for car dealerships.

A $1.3 trillion industry, auto dealerships sell 96% of the 16 million new cars sold each year. Yet they universally run on outdated systems and manual processes, which is why dealerships spend $36B each year on operations. That’s our opportunity.

We’ve grown insanely quickly with a small, scrappy team and continue to move at that pace.

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to be the connective tissue between us and our customers, sitting right at the center of one of the fastest-moving stories in AI right now. Renew and expand: Own retention and growth across your accounts, multi-rooftop rollouts, new use cases, more volume, and be the one who spots the opportunity first.
Be the connective tissue to product: Get a front-row seat translating what's happening inside dealerships into real product feedback, spotting patterns and helping shape what we build next.

Must Have

Proven Customer Success Execution: Experience owning a book of business and driving adoption/retention in a fast-moving environment.
Early-Stage Experience: Experience in a customer-facing role at an early-stage B2B SaaS company, you know what it takes to build trust with customers before a big brand name is doing the work for you.
Sharp Communication: Clear, confident, and organized with dealers. Strong at leading calls, training teams, and writing clean follow-ups.
Operational Discipline: Strong CRM hygiene, notes, tasks, and consistent account plans. You follow process diligently and run a tight ship.
Customer Obsessed: You build real relationships with the people you work with and genuinely care about their outcomes, not just the account health score.
High Ownership: You take full accountability for your accounts and follow through relentlessly, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
Excited to Be Early: You want to be part of a company at its earliest, most electric stage, energized by that even while working inside an evolving process rather than building one from scratch.

Experience with dealer tech ecosystems (DMS/CRM/schedulers, call tracking, BDC workflows)
Experience scaling onboarding across multi-rooftop groups
Comfort with light technical coordination (integrations, data mapping, troubleshooting)
Experience with QBRs tied to dealership KPIs (RO count, appointments, CSI, retention)

Why Flai

This is about as early as it gets: real traction, customers who genuinely love the product, and investors who've backed some of the best companies in the world betting big on us. You'll be living inside one of the most exciting build-outs in AI right now, in an industry that's about to look completely different because of what we're building. How you run a call, handle an escalation, or close a renewal in the next 12 months will directly shape how Flai serves customers for years to come. We move fast and we have fun doing it. Come be part of the story while it's still being written.
